# and the live site at https://usydastro.org/ both stand at:
LIVE_SERVER_GIT_REV=da68c82
#
# This file's own commit is bookkeeping on top of that rev, so it is one commit
# ahead of what it records; the authoritative marker is the server's
# ~/suas-data/.deploy-commit (now da68c82).
#
# How this deploy ran: per DEPLOY.md -- git push origin HEAD:main, then
# sshpass ssh 'cd public_html && git pull' on the host (the flow in README.md,
# Deploying). The pull was a fast-forward whose diffstat listed exactly
# admin.php and assets/css/style.css, so photographs were untouched by it.
#
# Verified on da68c82:
#  - no hybrid: local, origin/main and the server all resolve to da68c82, and
#    admin.php plus assets/css/style.css are md5-identical between the committed
#    bytes (git show HEAD:...) and the files on the server
#  - the sign out button sits beside the Admin heading: the served /admin.php
#    carries the admin__head wrapper around the <h1>Admin</h1>, the served
#    assets/css/style.css carries the .admin__head flex row (space-between,
#    centered, 18px gap, wraps on narrow windows) with .admin__head h1
#    margin-bottom 0 and .admin__logout margin 0, and the signed-out page
#    answers 200 with no Sign out button anywhere in it
#  - the layout was rendered locally from the committed bytes in both states:
#    desktop (1280px) shows title left and Sign out right on one row, a ~413px
#    window keeps them on one row, and the signed-out page shows no button and
#    an unchanged title area
#  - sign out still works through the moved form: a real POST of
#    action=logout against the running code flipped the session from signed in
#    to signed out (the page served "Sign in" afterwards); the logout handler
#    itself is unchanged by this revision
#  - signed-in rendering was not loaded on the live site -- no admin password is
#    available to the agent (same limitation as the previous record); the
#    signed-in layout evidence above comes from local rendering of the same
#    committed bytes
#  - /, /admin.php and the stylesheet all answer 200 over HTTPS, and
#    photos/submissions/30.jpg and photos/01.jpg still answer 200
#  - the server's ~/suas-data/.deploy-commit was updated to da68c82 after
#    verification
#
# State, not a fault of the deploy:
#  - this worktree carried an unstaged edit to assets/css/style.css
#    (.admin__actions button flex sizing) made outside this deploy; it was left
#    unstaged and is not on the server -- the server matches the commit bytes,
#    not the dirty worktree. The local `git pull --rebase` from DEPLOY.md step 0
#    therefore refused to run, harmlessly: local main was already at da68c82,
#    which this deploy had pushed moments before (fetch-confirmed)
#  - the server's working tree holds intentional deletions: photos/20.jpg,
#    photos/queue/22.jpg and 23.jpg and their thumbnails (taken down or
#    rejected earlier). git pull leaves them alone while no commit touches
#    photos/, but deploy.sh's rsync steps would restore them, so deploy.sh
#    remains unusable until its photos step is fixed
#  - mail.log records the earlier notification as "sent", which means the host's
#    MTA took it. Whether it reaches an inbox rather than a spam folder is not
#    something this file can attest to; SPF and DMARC exist for usydastro.org
#  - the From address is photos@usydastro.org, which is not a mailbox or a
#    forwarder on this account. It is on the sending domain, which is what SPF
#    needs, and replies go to the submitter via Reply-To. Set notify_from in
#    ~/suas-config.php if that should change
